initial_query: Analyze warranty terms across product licensing agreements

report_sections.title: Warranty Overview
report_sections.content: This analysis examines warranty provisions in product licensing agreements to identify patterns and variations.

report_sections.title: Limited Warranty Provisions
report_sections.content: All reviewed agreements include limited warranties covering product functionality for 90 days from delivery. The warranties guarantee that products will substantially conform to published specifications during this period.

report_sections.title: Warranty Disclaimers
report_sections.content: The licensing agreements disclaim all warranties, express or implied, including merchantability and fitness for a particular purpose. Products are provided 'as-is' with no representations about quality or suitability.

report_sections.title: Warranty Remedies
report_sections.content: If products fail to meet warranty terms, the sole remedy is replacement or repair at the vendor's option. No refunds or monetary damages are available for warranty breaches.
